dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The residents of the Grand Bazaar are all so talented!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They sell their own woven goods, beautiful vases and jars, and delicious-smelling spices that make Paimon's tummy start rumbling...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And they all sing and dance really well! Paimon wishes she could do that.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well, if you're serious about it, there's no reason you couldn't learn.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah! Paimon always forgets how useful flying can be!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright then! Let's go bust a move at the Grand Bazaar and watch everyone shower Paimon with admiration!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Aha, so that's what this is all about.

choices.text: You have a natural advantage when it comes to dancing.
